CheckTitle: Ensure no Network ACLs allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to SSH port 22
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks whether network ACLs allow inbound traffic from the internet to TCP port 22, evaluating rules in order.
Risk: NACLs are a stateless second layer of defence; allowing SSH from anywhere removes that layer for whole subnets.

Recommendation.Text: Add a deny rule for 0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0 on port 22 ahead of any allow-all rule, or restrict the allow rules to known CIDRs.
